answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 7 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The relic debit happens at intake, prism totals the burned amount, and pigment anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus burns the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
